title: Reality in the Divine Presence Never Changes
body:
Dastoor ya Sayyidee, madad.
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Stand up for the honor of the Seal of Prophets. We are saying Allahu akbar, Allahu
akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi ‘l-hamd! (Mawlana sits.)
From pre-Eternal up to Eternal, we like to say this that you may be holy ones. We are going to be dressed a
dress of honor from heavenly levels. O People! Beware, don’t lose your precious life. Don’t lose your being
through this life. Try to reach more and more glory and honors from heavenly levels. O our Lord! Forgive us
and bless us. We are weak servants and we are giving our most high honors to the most honored one in the
Divine Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). O our Lord! Zidhu, give more and more and more to Your most
beloved one through Your Divine Presence. Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `alayka wa `ala aalika wa ashaabika...ila
yawmu ‘d-deen.
We are asking from Allah Almighty to grant much more honor to the most high one in the Divine Presence,
and also to be decorated by ornaments for the honor of this night. We hope that the Lord of Heavens grants
us also from the honor of this holy night. That is most perfect. There can’t be any imperfection. Everything
must be perfect. Allah Almighty likes everything that His servant is doing to be perfect. You are the only one

who can do intercession in the Divine Presence; his declarations are through his teachings, because the Seal
of Prophets (s) is the teacher for everything on this planet!
Forgive us and grant us from the holy levels of heavens! We are happy and we have been honored to be here
through such a holy meeting. Not only this planet but countless planets and countless worlds. Countless
dominions are full with creatures. You can’t add them. An association; and we hope that they should grant us
much more honors through that heavenly declaration which we are representing. The holiness of heavens on
this planet.
Now we are coming and asking from the master, from the guide of this world, the pole for this planet. You
can’t send a car without a steering wheel; there must be one. Everything that the Lord of Heavens is doing is
well known through the Seal of Prophets’ ahadeeth. How they should reach to their heavenly beings or how
they should reach their holy beings. You can’t reach to them. Everything that the Lord of Heavens is doing is
just perfect. Now; one of His deputies on this planet had been dressed with a wazeefah, a mission. It is just
granted. That mission that he had been dressed with must be perfect. It can’t be imperfect. Therefore, such
heavenly ones have a perfection granted to them from heavens. They have been dressed and also just granted
power. As much as they may need, the power is going with them. It is never leaving them. If that power is
leaving them, this falling down as nothing and coming to the point of zero. But when that heavenly power
going beside of that one or through that one, there must be perfection for reaching to his mission. May Allah
grant us, for the honor of the Seal of Prophets, something to understand.
We are working on it. They are working to teach Mankind about their holy beings. Everyone is just granted a
physical being, but at the same time they have been granted another being. That being is going to be heavenly
being. It is everything that all the Prophets coming to teach people and finally, the Seal of Prophets (s)
coming to teach people. Yes, sir! When they are reaching to their holy beings; we shall come on that point.
Someone is asking and answers are coming. I am directing that question to the master of this world. He must
know everything that we can ask. We are saying, whole greetings to you, O our master.
The greetings that we are saying to the master of this world are not material greetings. They are not greetings
from a physical being to another physical being. But, when we are saying, "Greetings on you," we are asking
for greetings from heavens to reach him. And when we are asking, he is also sending us from his real

heavenly being some rays of heavenly lights. They are reaching our hearts, to make it to work and to
understand.
O People, who are asking to hear something else. Every night it must be something else. Even, every hour it
may be something else; through every minute it may be a special reaching and understanding coming to you.
And in less time, the smallest time; there is something new coming through that smallest part of time. There
are minutes and seconds. Though you may go down you can’t find an end when you are dividing time. You
can’t find an end. That is the Greatness of the Lord of Creation. Yes. He is granting us new understandings
every time. New ones are coming every moment and every second. This one never going to be same as that
because Allah Almighty never making a photocopy. No!
Therefore, all minutes or seconds have a special being; with a special understanding, special lightening,
special wisdoms. He is Lord of Creation. Everything that you can imagine and beyond that imagination, the
Lord of Heavens may bring. New ones, new ones, new ones. Even when we are saying "new", the second
"new" is not the same as the first "new." We are reaching one level and you are saying it is a new level. Then
the Lord’s command is to take you from that level to another level. It is not the same. Everything, even the
word, "new" is changing. How many words can you speak for giving an explanation on "new." You may say
two or three different words for understanding but when the Lord of Heavens giving a new "new," the new
"new" has another name. It has another meaning, another understanding and it has other lightenings. La
yashbahu shay’an, nothing can be similar for the Lord’s Being. Mukhtalif, everything is in contrary to what
we are knowing. That is Allah. Allahu akbar! Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem. Ya Rabbee laka ‘l-hamd.
Shukr ya Rabbee.
We are in need more and more. You can’t say that His existence is different if He is not giving what creation
needs in every moment, or second, or third. His existence is just different for everything in this existence.
(Mawlana expresses his awe of Allah (swt)). In every minute or in every second, no need to be changed; may
be in its same position but another being coming. You may be astonished from that and over that another
understanding is coming. Another world or another level of life; that is never going to be same or similar to
what you are in. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar. This thing(s) that we are granted to say to people
is a teaching and training for an understanding that is getting up and up. Wider and higher, wider and higher,
wider and higher. You are going to be astonished what is happening. He is Allah Almighty! Everything must

be new!
Therefore words in Arabic, kullu jadeedun, ladheedhun, every new one is going to be much more tasteful.
Allah Almighty never coming through matooq or to be surrounded. No! Leaving Him; everything that belongs
to Him is on heavens. Seven heavens. How many heavens is each heaven representing? Countless heavens
through each heaven. We are knowing Seven heavens but you can’t reach an end through each level of
heavens. You can’t reach an end, adding the numbers through the heavens from heavens.
You must be happy. O People, come and listen. (Whom) they are coming from holy words of the Seal of
Prophets. We are not reaching to the Holy Qur’an. The Holy Qur’an is only opening for the Seal of Prophets.
The Lord granted it to him, hand by hand. What about Jibra’eel (a)? Jibra’eel was only as a shaahid;
witnessing. The Lord of Heavens was granting to Jibra’eel and his holy being. And Jibra’il’s holy being
bringing it to the first level figure of the Seal of Prophets on this planet. And Qur’an Kareem, holy book
descending, coming. What do you think about Jibra’il (a)? Where is his station? In the Divine Presence? Yes.
Or on Earth? Where he is coming for bringing Holy Qur’an to the Seal of Prophets? Is he coming from his
real station, coming down? What do you think? He is in the Divine Presence like this? If that command is
coming, he is leaving and coming on Earth from Sidratu ‘l-Muntaha, (the Lote-Tree of the Furthest Limit)?
How? So many secret knowledges that people can’t be able to open until their physical being is going to be
melted, finished. When finishing you can understand. Only one figure coming on Earth in front of Prophet (s)
by the holy command of Allah Almighty. And don’t think that the Prophet’s real being is on Earth. No.
You now have a small camera. You are looking and it is showing. You are here, speaking, moving, sitting and
standing. But... you are not here; but also you are here. Moving and speaking. How it can be in such a way? At
least, for understanding through that machine, you are going to appear as people but your real being is not
there. Therefore, when revelation coming don’t think that Archangel Jibra’eel with his greatness is coming on
Earth and sitting with the Prophet. Only that surah, picture is there. You are looking and seeing here; real
being is there. Can’t move, impossible. Impossible for the Seal of Prophet (s) and other prophets who are
always in the Divine and heavenly Presence to leave that and to come on Earth. No. What is just shown is as
that machine is showing you. Jibra’eel has hundreds and hundreds of wings; that is the greatness of wings;
you may put on it such and such planets, like our planet and never feeling or getting to be heavy on him. That
is reality. That is from that reality; a looking, an appearance. Therefore, appearances are countless. But real

reality in the Divine Presence can’t move. Can’t move and we are here. What we are saying is always for the
Greatness of the Lord of Heavens. You are thirsty and you are drinking one cup of water and at the same time
your whole body is leaving to be thirsty. How it can be?
And new teachings are coming for making heavenly positions more clear because we are reaching the end of
the period on this planet. Last Days are approaching and this is a new opening. Before no, but now it is
opening. Forty years ago such instruments were never in existence. Understanding for it now, but at that time
we were not using such things because it was not open. Now every secret ocean(s) is getting to be open
through an atom for Mankind. And that atom is going to be as an ocean for Mankind.
O People! Beware! Shaytan is trying to reach to peoples’ minds and to spoil the understanding of Mankind; so
that they are not understanding anything for the Greatness of the Lord of Heavens who created Man. And to
make people to ask, "How!" Where is Allah!" If you are saying, "With you," he is saying, "No." How you can
say no? If not there, how you are going to be in life; going, coming, eating, drinking and understanding. By
yourself? It can’t be. We are not seeing, coming from outside but our relationship is coming from heavens.
Mankind’s relationship is always through heavens.
O People! Try to collect heavenly inspirations. heavenly inspirations come to you to give an opening for new
understanding through endless levels of understanding. That is our mission. He created and He is asking His
creatures to know their real identity. Real identity can’t be known through yourself; may be through your
connection; through your real being through heavens. May Allah forgive us.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, SubhaanAllah
Dome, dome, dome, dome 8x
With heavenly music, realities reaching to our real being and you are going to be so happy, in pleasure and in
lights, you can’t bring any description on it.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah

Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah , Sultaan Allah
Dome, dome, dome, dome 4x
If a person is reaching such a level it is because he is enlightened and granted a holy taste from heavens. If he
had been thrown through Hell he is never changing, never understanding what fire making on his physical
being. Thanks to our grandshaykh also and the Seal of Prophets (s), Allah (swt) gives more and more honors
and we are making our sajdah for the Lord of Heavens, our Creator.
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar.
Fatihah.
[44 minutes]
